text:
Type: natural fibre runner rug
Use: covering a long narrow floor, hallways and beside beds or kitchen counters; hallway, entryway, kitchen
Style: coastal, Scandinavian, rustic
Materials: tightly woven natural sisal-like fibre, fabric-bound edges
Colors: warm natural tan, light brown
Shape: long narrow rectangle, flat, fine woven texture, neat bound border, slim and light
Feel: natural, earthy, calm
Goes with: white walls, light or warm wood, rattan, linen; coastal, Japandi or Scandinavian homes

product.name: OSTED
product.description: The rug is hard-wearing and durable because its made of sisal, a natural fibre taken from the agave plant.
